content: Mesa lavapipe is Mesa's official software Vulkan ICD (now Vulkan 1.4), implemented on top of llvmpipe (Mesa's Gallium3D LLVM-JIT CPU rasterizer, multithreaded across cores). Like SwiftShader, this is a driver-level software implementation of the Vulkan API loaded via the normal Vulkan ICD loader mechanism (VK_ICD_FILENAMES / installable client driver) -- not a C++ application library you link against or vendor as source into an app's render pipeline in the conventional thirdparty/ sense. Reported to outperform SwiftShader in several benchmarks. Part of the broader Mesa project (MIT/permissive licensed core, though Mesa as a whole is a large multi-license codebase).
